title: AI server maker xFusion gets approval from the Shenzhen Stock Exchange for a ChiNext IPO; filing: the company aims to raise ~$1.2B by issuing up to 220M shares (Sangmi Cha/Bloomberg)
summary: Sangmi Cha / Bloomberg: AI server maker xFusion gets approval from the Shenzhen Stock Exchange for a ChiNext IPO; filing: the company aims to raise ~$1.2B by issuing up to 220M shares — Artificial intelligence server maker xFusion Digital Technologies Co. received approval from the Shenzhen Stock Exchange on Thursday …
